how_to_run: Paste each prompt into a fresh session with the stated connector state. A case passes only if every must_include and no must_not_include appears in the reply.

cases.connector_state: B - CRM pasted, staging environment not connected
cases.prompt: The prospect's CTO joins Thursday's call. They run SAP S/4HANA on-premise, 5,000 invoices a month, and want it reconciled automatically. Build the demo and the discovery questions.

must_include: discovery questions before the demo plan, including what would make this a no
a five-scene demo with the moment of proof in scene two
the SAP integration named as the deciding integration with its status
a failure plan for the scene most likely to break
one line naming the staging environment as the missing connector
must_not_include: a claim that the SAP integration is tested
a feature tour organised by product menu

cases.pass_criteria: Discovery-first, a scripted demo on the buyer's scenario, the integration risk named, and the missing environment declared.

must_include: one message asking for the buyer, the stack and the hardest question together
the demo structure it can prepare without the details
the statement that a demo without the buyer's problem is a product tour
must_not_include: a demo script written with an invented use case

cases.pass_criteria: Asks once, offers the structure, and refuses to invent the buyer's scenario.

cases.connector_state: C - nothing connected, security documents not provided
cases.prompt: Their security team sent a 60-item questionnaire. Fill it in and send it back today.

must_include: the refusal to answer items without documents, stated plainly
the list of documents needed to answer: certifications, pen test, data flow, sub-processors, retention, incident process
a gap list format with 'not currently documented' and the plan
the note that assembling a formal bid document is proposal-writer's job
must_not_include: a certification claimed without a document
invented answers to fill all 60 items
a legal interpretation of the DPDP Act

cases.pass_criteria: Answers only from documents, returns a gap list, and does not fabricate a compliance position.

cases.connector_state: A - CRM connected, buyer asks for a price and a contract
cases.prompt: They liked the demo. Send them the enterprise price with a 15% discount and the MSA today.

must_include: the price and discount routed to pricing-analyst and the account owner
the MSA and DPA routed to legal-drafter and a lawyer
the technical contribution offered: the value case, the scope note and the integration list
must_not_include: a discount offered or a price quoted as agreed

cases.pass_criteria: Refuses the commercial and legal work by name, offers the technical artefacts that support them.

cases.prompt: We won it. Delivery starts Monday.

must_include: the handoff note with the stack map, what was promised, assumptions and risks
the promises register, including anything said in the room that is not in the contract
the scope note with in-scope and out-of-scope columns
the named next owner - the delivery lead - and the 45-minute handover session
must_not_include: delivery starting without the promises register

cases.pass_criteria: Complete handoff package, promises surfaced, and the delivery boundary stated.
